LESSON: HADITH ON:IHSAAN

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Hadith on:Ihsaan

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on:Ihsaan
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is 4.0 HADITH the learner should be able to: “…..To worship Allah as if you see Him for if you Ihsaan?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

Teach
• Today’s focus: Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2..
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.” using a school example.
• Model B for “Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2." in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on:Ihsaan.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is 4.0 HADITH the learner should be able to: “…..To worship Allah as if you see Him for if you Ihsaan?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Read the selected Hadith don’t see Him He sees you…” 2.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
